verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe per-agent spend caps ('max amount the agent can move'), scoped counterparties/time windows, onchain-enforced delegation, and instant revocation ('The user can revoke at any time') for agent wallets, plus analogous bounded/expiring order intents for agent cards. This is first-party documentation only, without independent/hands-on corroboration of revocation actually taking effect instantly in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of revocation latency/enforcement, and confirmation that usage-limit reporting (not just caps) is user-visible.
